value.command: On an isolated Debug emulator use DiagnosticsTestRunner with an explicit synthetic DSN for offline/walk, account queue and track delivery suites; select the emulator serial in every adb command.
steps: Build Lisa Debug/test APKs with diagnosticDeliveryChecks=true; grant storage, location and POST_NOTIFICATIONS only to the isolated emulator.

Run adb -s <isolated-emulator-serial> shell am instrument -w -r -e class com.nextgis.mobile.reliability.SyncOfflineAndWalkGpsTest,com.nextgis.mobile.reliability.SyncNotificationsTest,com.nextgis.mobile.util.ProjectSyncRunnerTest,com.nextgis.mobile.reliability.TrackUploadTest -e diagnosticsDsn http://synthetic@127.0.0.1:9/1 -e diagnosticsRun sync-offline-walk com.nextgis.mobile.debug.test/com.nextgis.mobile.util.DiagnosticsTestRunner.
value.expected: Disconnected manual tap/retry shows No internet connection without dispatching sync or changing last-sync time. Error notification uses the same readable text. Account work stays ENQUEUED with zero attempts until network returns; disconnected runner and track delivery retain queues/points without HTTP. GPS loss/timestamp gap resumes automatically without dropping the first usable fix or releasing point locks; explicit pause and sticky user pause state remain intact. No physical phone or production NGW accounts.
